name: Agentik
description: Hosted Agentik tool gateway: one MCP connection gives an agent 2,400+ third-party tools from 52 providers. The agent inspects a tool's schema and price before running it; paid calls are charged at the provider's price from a prepaid Agentik balance, with no separate provider keys for supported tools. Sign in with OAuth; public discovery without an account at https://ai.agentik.cc/mcp/public.
author: Agentik
